column1: # derivation: stat_rows WHERE g < 3 keeps g = 1 and g = 2 (§1.2). MEDIAN
# skips NULLs (§2.1): g = 1 has i = 2, 5, 8 and f = 1.0, 2.5, 4.0, three
# values each, so the median is the middle one, 5 and 2.5; g = 2 has one
# value, 7 and -0.5. An odd count has one middle value, so the answer does
# not depend on how two middle values would be combined, which the document
# does not state. Types: MEDIAN of an integer or FLOAT64 is FLOAT64 (§8.16),
